title: Shared analytical population controls
question: Can one typed population serve set validation and replay on Arrow and Parquet with the selected library builds?
method: Compare synthetic Arrow and Parquet inputs against independent expected answers. Inspect the CLI plan and exercise connection reuse and a truncated file.

results.name: Independent expectations matched by each scan
results.note: Scope includes only the synthetic population.

conclusion: The checked set queries give equal answers on both typed inputs. Structural Arrow validation accepts the fixture with invalid population facts. Connection draining and durable publication require separate ownership.
